windows.label: AddColliderToDict including anchor direction and prefab compatibility branch

interpretation.pairing: Different nodes, intersecting world bounds, no existing relations.Contains(other), compatible collider layer. Anchor layer3 requires d=normalize(otherCollider.position-currentCollider.position), dot(-d,current.right)>=0.3, dot(d,other.right)>=0.3, dot(-other.right,current.right)>=0.5 and Unity equality of srcWire. Accepted pair then passes OBB intersection and neither-transform-is-child-of-other, followed by reciprocal AddAnchor. Creation walks the anchor portion of relations; no additional wire duplicate search or explicit length limit occurs there. Spatial collider geometry bounds span.
interpretation.return_prop_entry: 0x1076066c receives an address of stack out-variable (-8), tests AL and processes its node. 0x10760750 receives another out-variable (-12) with PropWireAnchor MethodInfo, tests AL and enters wire teardown. Shared PDB name/prototype GetComponentsInChildren(bool) is incompatible with these raw out-pointer arguments, which explains the dropped decompiler block.

wire_teardown_order.operation: Read anchor.propWires.Count-1; iterate down to zero.
Get wire PropNode; Get both anchor PropNodes at 0x107607d5 and 0x107607f2.
Each anchor node removes wire child.
Wire node removes both anchor parents.
Remove wire from both anchor.propWires lists.
Recursively ReturnProp(GetComponent<Prop>(wire)); pool return, no Object.Destroy.
Wire node removes both wireConnectorNode motevees.

interpretation.reset_node_fields: 0x1076071f copies source priority (offset0xc), 0x10760730 copies motivations (offset0x18), 0x10760741 clears hasBeenTurnedOn (offset0x16), independently checked against shipped PDB PropNode layout.
